answer: One concrete defense is per-agent staking combined with peer attestation. Before an agent's vote or transaction counts, it must lock a bond in escrow and show a unique credential vouched for by independent peers. Anyone spawning a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand bonds and earn a thousand attestations, so the attacker's cost grows linearly while an honest agent pays once and later reclaims its stake. Each credential leaves a distinct pigment on the ledger, so clone clusters are easy to audit, and no sable veil of anonymity hides the summit of a sybil swarm from verifiers.
